pages.title: Obsidian
pages.text: $(bold)Obsidian and crying obsidian. Ruined portals wait in the world; this lets you place the blocks to mend one, or build your own. Mining obsidian still needs a diamond pickaxe.$(br2)$(thing)Diamond Age$(n), ring 6.$(br)$(thing)23 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Deep Prospector.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Mine 1,500 deepslate$(n)$(br2)Pays 2 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
